name: Hotend (heater block + nozzle)
description: A heater block with cartridge and nozzle in E3D style. Wire its 'heater' signal to the board and drive it with duty 0..1 — a lumped thermal model heats and cools the block (params: heater_power_w, thermal_mass_j_per_k, cooling_w_per_k). Mounts under a bolt head; attach a thermistor in a real rig.
